Junior null propagation distinguishes invalid parse from valid Number0, then checks complete consumption and final finiteness. Reference and senior already rejected nonfinite finals. Each parser rejects division by a zero-valued right operand before outer operations can hide it; NaN/nonfinite final results become null. Literal regex has no exponent/hex/trailing-dot path. Native compiler revocation applies only to this milestone and later inheritors, not earlier valid checkpoints or unrelated tasks/host. The trusted Run compiler remains private and call expressions become closures rather than direct eval. Getter-only globals prevent observed QuickJS value-only descriptor replacement; constructors are revoked in all four families.
